reason: Primary purpose is user-interface optimization in DSH WebUI: the plugin consolidates repeated tool-call cards into grouped, collapsible display units to reduce chat clutter. It is a front-end visualization/layout enhancement for conversation logs, with configurable scope and grouping, while leaving underlying conversation data semantics intact. This is evidenced by its README implementation details and web-only plugin configuration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH WebUI 中将连续的同类工具调用以“主卡片+紧凑子行”形式展示，减少聊天流中的重复卡片噪音，并支持按工具列表、分组方式和最大组大小进行配置。
summaries.en: This plugin renders consecutive same-type tool calls in DSH WebUI as a compact parent/child card view to reduce chat flow clutter, with options to configure target tools, grouping mode, and maximum group size.

capabilities: Groups consecutive tool-call entries in the DSH WebUI chat flow into a compact parent/child row presentation.
Supports configurable merging by tool whitelist and grouping mode/size options for adjacent or per-step tool-call sets.
Uses a client-side slot override to customize tool row rendering while preserving raw chat snapshots and non-target nodes.
Adds configurable expand/collapse interaction for merged child rows to reduce visual noise from repeated calls.

reasons.code: Repository README states the plugin merges continuous adjacent same-tool calls into a main-card plus compact child-row tree view in WebUI conversation flow.
README details `tools`, `groupBy`, and `maxGroupSize` config controls and default handling for built-in tools.
Package manifest marks the plugin as a web client plugin with inject runtime UI modules and web platform target, indicating front-end only behavior.
